text:
[LGRA.9.6.1] Postfix productions:

```
postfix ::= primary postfix_op*
postfix_op ::= '.' NAME                                        # slot access, Json key, or member (LGRA.9.6.2)
            |  '[' expression ']'                              # index
            |  '(' argument_list? ')'                          # call: a built-in function, or a member's arguments
            |  '::' TYPE_SYM NULLABLE?                         # conversion cast (LCST.4)
argument_list ::= expression (',' expression)*
```
